title: A Friday Evening
setting: A bright, clean family home: a kitchen and a living room with a sofa. Ben's baby cousin is visiting.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper)

sentences.en: On Friday evening, Ben cooks rice for dinner.
sentences.zh: 星期五晚上，本煮米饭当晚餐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) stirs a pot of rice on the stove, the kitchen window dark with evening sky.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben cooking rice in the evening; the day (Friday) can't be shown.

sentences.en: He spills some water on the clean floor.
sentences.zh: 他把一些水洒在了干净的地板上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) looks surprised as water splashes from a jug onto a shiny clean kitchen floor.

sentences.en: Ben is sorry, but Dad just smiles.
sentences.zh: 本很抱歉，但爸爸只是笑了笑。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) looks sorry with his hands together while his dad Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) smiles kindly and holds a mop.

sentences.en: After dinner, Dad washes the baby's feet.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后，爸爸给宝宝洗脚。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) gently washes the little feet of a chubby baby in a white onesie in a small bowl of water, empty dinner plates on the table behind.

sentences.en: The baby often laughs when Ben says his name.
sentences.zh: 本一叫宝宝的名字，他就常常咯咯笑。
sentences.scene_prompt: A chubby baby in a white onesie laughs happily while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) leans in and calls to him.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben calling to a laughing baby; 'often' and the name can't be shown.

sentences.en: Then Ben sits on the sofa with a book.
sentences.zh: 然后本拿着一本书坐到沙发上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) sits on a soft sofa in the living room, opening a book.

sentences.en: It is a history book about France.
sentences.zh: 这是一本关于法国历史的书。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) holds up a big book with the Eiffel Tower and an old French castle on the cover.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a book with French castle pictures; 'history' is only hinted by the old castle.

sentences.en: He reads half of it in his warm socks.
sentences.zh: 他穿着暖和的袜子，读了一半。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) lies on the sofa with his feet up in thick warm striped socks, the book open at its middle.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben reading in warm socks with the book open in the middle; 'half' is only hinted.
